schema.title: Response List Organizations Api Organizations Get
Response List Contacts Api Contacts Get
Response List Deals Api Deals Get

post.description: Moves a card on the board. The response is the saved card with its new number.

ActivityIn.title: ActivityIn
ActivityIn.description: A note, call or email, logged on exactly one contact or deal.

BandStage.title: BandStage
BandStage.description: One block of the pipeline band (DASH-9).

ContactDeal.title: ContactDeal
ContactDeal.description: A deal where the contact is the main contact.

ContactImpact.title: ContactImpact
ContactImpact.description: Deals keep existing without a main contact; activities are deleted.

ContactPatch.title: ContactPatch
ContactPatch.description: Only the fields sent are changed. A name and status can't be emptied.

DealImpact.title: DealImpact
DealImpact.description: Activities logged on the deal, stage changes included, are deleted with it.

DealMove.title: DealMove
DealMove.description:
The card's new stage and the cards it now sits between: `after_id` is the
card above it and `before_id` the card below. Either may be empty.

DealPatch.title: DealPatch
DealPatch.description:
Only the fields sent are changed. A field sent counts as set by hand
in this save, so a probability or close date sent with a new stage is kept
(RULE-3). Name, stage and value can't be emptied.

DealSaved.title: DealSaved
DealSaved.description: The saved deal, and the main contact if the save made them a customer (RULE-7).

Figures.title: Figures
Figures.description: The four figures (DASH-3 to DASH-6) and the header's summary counts (DASH-2).

FunnelStage.title: FunnelStage
FunnelStage.description: Value and deals that reached a stage, and the value's share of New's (DASH-10).

MonthFigures.title: MonthFigures
MonthFigures.description: One month of both charts (DASH-7, DASH-8), as YYYY-MM.

OrganizationImpact.title: OrganizationImpact
OrganizationImpact.description: What deleting it leaves behind: these keep existing without the link.

OrganizationPatch.title: OrganizationPatch
OrganizationPatch.description: Only the fields sent are changed. A name can't be emptied.

OrganizationRow.title: OrganizationRow
OrganizationRow.description: A row of the organizations table: with its contact count and open pipeline.

Pipeline.title: Pipeline
Pipeline.description:
Six columns in stage order, cards in place order. Won and Lost hold the
deals closed since `window_start` (RULE-14). The totals are open deals only.

RecordRef.title: RecordRef
RecordRef.description: The contact or deal an activity is on.
